newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN BLACK ECONOMY EXCEEDS 20 PCT OF GDP - STUDY.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN BLACK ECONOMY EXCEEDS 20 PCT OF GDP - STUDY.

text.p: The size of the black economy in Belgium is equivalent to more than 20 percent of gross domestic product (GDP), according to a study by an Austrian academic highlighted in the Economist magazine this weekend.
Only Italy and Spain have larger black economies, according to the study by Friedrich Schneider of Linz University.
Schneider based his study on the amount of unexplained cash and transactions in various economies, the Economist reported.
